content_sections.heading: How Will Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit based on 80% weightage of marks in graduate degree in Music or equivalent Experience: 3 marks per year, maximum 15 marks National / State level music certificates: maximum 5 marks Merit and selection list prepared school-wise, subject to document verification 80% of marks of the graduate degree in Music or equivalent Experience in the related field: 3 marks per year, maximum 15 marks Selection committee chaired by the District Education Officer, approved by the Collector Subject experts to be on the face-to-face interview panel

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed format Self-attested certificates of 10th, 12th, graduation in Music, experience and others Self-attested Chhattisgarh domicile certificate, and caste certificate if required Live employment exchange registration certificate Self-attested passport-size photograph pasted on the form Affidavit on Rs. 10 stamp paper that all documents are true

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the District NIC Surajpur website https://surajpur.nic.in and print it. Fill the form in the prescribed format and attach self-attested educational certificates and other documents. Paste a self-attested passport-size photograph at the marked place. Attach an affidavit on Rs. 10 stamp paper that all enclosed documents are true. Appear in person on 07-12-2026 and submit the application between 11:30 and 01:00. Submit a separate application for each PM SHRI / SAGES school.

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the District Education Officer, Samagra Shiksha (RMSA), District Surajpur (C.G.), dated 23 September 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 7 December 2026, and candidates report at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 1 Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Premnagar), 1 Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Nawapara), 1 Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Batra), 1 Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Ramanujnagar), 1 Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Jaynagar), 1 Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Odgi) and 7 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Samagra Shiksha Surajpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 7 December 2026 at 11:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years. Relaxation: Age relaxation as per prevailing government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 10,000 per month (fixed lump-sum honorarium) for Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Premnagar), Rs. 10,000 per month (fixed lump-sum honorarium) for Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Nawapara), Rs. 10,000 per month (fixed lump-sum honorarium) for Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Batra), Rs. 10,000 per month (fixed lump-sum honorarium) for Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Ramanujnagar), Rs. 10,000 per month (fixed lump-sum honorarium) for Music Instructor (PM SHRI SAGES Vidyalaya Jaynagar).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate degree in Music or an equivalent degree from a recognised university or institute; experience in music education preferred; residents of Chhattisgarh only. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only residents of Chhattisgarh are eligible. Applicant must be a citizen of India.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates removed from service by the government or whose service extension has been stopped. Candidates convicted of any offence against women or any other offence.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit based on 80% weightage of marks in graduate degree in Music or equivalent. Experience: 3 marks per year, maximum 15 marks. National / State level music certificates: maximum 5 marks. Merit and selection list prepared school-wise, subject to document verification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary engagement up to 31 March 2027. Period may be extended if Government of India approval and honorarium are received for the next session. No appointment or contract appointment order; only a work order will be issued.
